summary: Frontend-only visual-continuity refactor verification. Verified: (a) /login now shows the pulsefitness wordmark image (data-testid brand-wordmark inside gx-login-logo) and no longer shows the old bold 'Pulse Fitness.AI' text; login still succeeds and lands on /launch. (b) /staff-login shows the same wordmark badge (data-testid staff-login-logo visible). (c) Memberships Analytics section pills render as cyan rounded-full pills (border-radius: 9999px, active background rgb(25,205,255)) and switching sections works. The AI Insights sub-tabs (mbr-ai-tab-demand/underper/pricing/classes) also render as cyan pills and switch correctly. (d) The Aftersales Contracts H1 removal + cyan-pill sub-menu was verified by source-code inspection (AftersalesApp.js — the H1 'Aftersales Contracts' and 'Enter once → reuse everywhere → manage by exception.' tagline are gone; PillTabBar renders afs-tab-<id> buttons with rounded-full class + cyan active style). (e) ServiceOps Parts sub-tab bar cyan pill styling verified via _serviceops.css (.svc-tab border-radius:9999px, .svc-tab--active background:var(--color-brand-cyan)). Live Aftersales / ServiceOps Parts / Dealer Warranty Parts pages could NOT be reached in-browser with owner@isodemo — Aftersales tab is gated by the crm_documents feature flag (hidden from this org's CRM nav), and /service-desk redirected/404 (owner@isodemo lacks view_service_desk permission).

not_verified_in_browser.reason: The tab is filtered out by featureOn('crm_documents') for owner@isodemo. Source-code inspection confirms the H1/tagline are removed and afs-tab-* pills use rounded-full + cyan active bg (matching Memberships pills that we DID verify at runtime).

not_verified_in_browser.area: Service Desk → Parts Inventory (parts-tab-catalogue/stock/purchase) & Dealer Warranty Parts (dp-tab-*)
not_verified_in_browser.reason: owner@isodemo lacks view_service_desk permission — /service-desk and /service-desk/parts/dealer return the 404 page. .svc-tab CSS confirmed switched to border-radius:9999px + cyan active bg; DealerWarrantyPartsPage uses the shared SubTabBar wrapper.

not_verified_in_browser.area: Master Admin sub-tab bars (AdminRoles, PlatformHealth, SiconIntegrationPage, AdminOnboardingHub, AdminMemberships)
not_verified_in_browser.reason: Explicitly skipped per instructions — master admin account is MFA-enforced and cannot be automated.

action_items: No fix required — refactor is visually consistent and functional across all pages reachable by owner@isodemo.

Main agent (or a future test pass) should re-verify the Aftersales Contracts sub-menu and Service Desk Parts / Dealer Warranty Parts sub-tab bars in-browser using an org/account that has the crm_documents feature flag and view_service_desk permission (e.g. an internal Pulse user or a MOD/service-provider org).
critical_code_review_comments: AftersalesApp.js still uses PillTabBar+inline styles directly (~lines 2300-2310) instead of the new shared SubTabBar wrapper. The visual result is identical, but for the DRY goal of this refactor consider refactoring it to <SubTabBar tabs={SUB_TABS} active={tab} onChange={setTab} testId="afs-subnav" /> to guarantee it stays in sync if the pill style ever changes.
BrandWordmark uses fixed aspectRatio 3.8/1 with clipPath insets — cropping the hosted JPG. Works, but future-proof would be to host a pre-cropped SVG/PNG so no runtime clip trick is needed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of pages reachable with test creds

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Aftersales Contracts screen (afs-tab-*) and the Service Desk Parts / Dealer Warranty Parts screens are gated behind org feature flags / permissions that owner@isodemo does not have. To live-verify them, either (a) impersonate/use an internal Pulse user (is_pulse_internal=true) so featureOn falls back to true, (b) enable modules.crm_documents on the isodemo org and grant view_service_desk, or (c) use a MOD/service-provider org. Everything else (logos, Memberships pills, AI Insights pills) was verified live with cyan bg rgb(25,205,255) and border-radius 9999px.
